rules: Source balancing never changes coverage floors or source evidence.
Rows removed from the corpus-facing ledger remain durable in source materialization evidence.
Selection keeps at most the coverage-policy dominant-source fraction and prefers one asset per recording group before additional members.
Balancing must preserve the global min_assets, min_independent_groups, min_sources and min_clip_duration_seconds floors for the target.
A row losing the balanced target remains only when another governed positive or hard-negative role remains; otherwise it is removed from the corpus-facing ledger.
Changing selection semantics requires a new policy identity.
